fields.summary: Claims 1-16 are rejected for nonstatutory double patenting over claims 1-11 of Patent No. 8523439 B2 in view of Piazze. The patent discloses an elastic drawstring trash bag with short seals but lacks a bag opening narrower than the overall bag width; Piazze teaches lateral short seals making the bag opening narrower than the overall bag width, and it would have been obvious to combine to make the bag easier to use.
